create.name: Jennifer Piercy
create.bio:
Jennifer Piercy is a yoga nidra guide, writer and mentor based in Victoria, British Columbia, whose work centres on rest, sleep and dreaming as spiritual ground rather than as a problem to fix. Through her practice, Sacred Sleep Yoga, she has spent more than fifteen years exploring how tiredness and the quiet hours of the night can open a person to intuition, imagination and a sense of the larger self. She treats slowing down as something to be honoured, and connects personal rest with the wellbeing of communities and the living world.

She is best known for her recorded yoga nidra and in-between-state meditations, first made for her own local students, which have since been played many millions of times by listeners around the world. Her style is unhurried and poetic, mixing breath and body awareness, invocation and space for intention. Alongside the recordings she created a ten-day short course on Insight Timer about building a deeper relationship with sleep, sells a small library of downloadable practices from her website, and meets people individually online for mentoring sessions.

courses.title: Your Guide to Deeper Sleep
courses.description: A ten-day audio course on Insight Timer, with sessions of about fifteen minutes a day. Jennifer looks at the beliefs we carry about sleep and invites listeners to treat rest as a path into meditation and inner guidance.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: One-on-one sessions with Jennifer
courses.description: Individual online mentoring sessions, booked through her calendar page. The conversations focus on a person's own relationship with rest, sleep and dreams, drawing on her years as a teacher and counsellor.

courses.title: Liminal Dreaming
courses.description: A downloadable guided recording for any hour of the day. It leads the listener into the drifting space between waking and dreaming, with time to rest the eyes and set a quiet intention.

courses.title: Restful Intuition
courses.description: A downloadable practice done lying down, moving attention through each of the senses and the felt sense of gut and heart. Jennifer presents it as a gentle way to strengthen intuition while resting.

courses.title: Shapeshifting Sleep
courses.description: A yoga nidra style recording for a daytime pause or for bedtime. It opens with an invocation, then moves through intention, layers of breath awareness and spacious body sensing.

courses.title: The Heart of Sleep
courses.description: A night-time recording built around soothing touch, soft breathing and body awareness. It closes by guiding the listener towards the dream world.

free_resources.title: Jennifer Piercy on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her free library of guided yoga nidra, rest and dream meditations, including some of the most played tracks on the app. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Sacred Sleep Meditation Recording
free_resources.description: A twenty-minute guided relaxation as an MP3, sent free when you join her mailing list from the home page. It can be done in any position, in bed or elsewhere.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 359.6k (profile, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram 2,837 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); Facebook page 530 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); no YouTube (she says any YouTube account in her name is fake) → ~363k total → luminary
flags: Her whole brand is sleep-focused (Sacred Sleep Yoga); kept items framed as rest, dreaming and sleep as a practice, but a human may want to check the sleep framing overall.
Last Insight Timer upload was about 3 years ago and her events page only shows old undated events; she still offers sessions and sells recordings, so treated as still teaching.
Her site warns that YouTube accounts using her name and an AI copy of her voice are impostors; no YouTube videos listed for that reason.
WebFetch would only quote the first sentence of her Insight Timer bio, so the bio check ran against that sentence plus her own site pages.
left_out: Healing Darkness recording ("healing" in the title).
Melatonin Magic and Bone Deep Sleep recordings (borderline sleep-aid framing; kept the list to the four clearest).
Rest-shop and Rest In Your Intuitive Powers live events (past, undated).
No books found; no YouTube (impostor accounts only).
